_doc: Double Dragon (Technos 1995) victim postures (export_bm.VICTIM_POSES['doubledr'], the vocabulary of tools/kof96/victim_poses98.json: posture + angle, ROM sprites face left, 0 upright, 90 horizontal head toward the facing side, -90 head toward the back, 180 head down). Keys 'anim.step' of the victim animations of Billy's throws (throw_dd.py: every character's 113 / 114 / 115 = thrown by the B / C / D throw, the same steps): step 0 held standing (Billy's def 2676), 1 lifted on the thrower's back (2677), 2 upside down over his head (2678), 3 and 4 the flight pose (884); after the landing the brawler's knockdown bounce (DD's 71) and down (73) play by role. Read by eye from Billy's frames (render: dd.draw_def 2676-2678, 884; the same picture in the game, /data/tmp/billy194/out).
